# Stellar Cleaning Solutions — full reference

> Stellar Cleaning Solutions LLC is an owner-operated commercial and residential
> cleaning company based in Corvallis, Oregon. It serves ten cities across two
> regions: the Willamette Valley and Central Oregon. The work splits into
> custodial and janitorial contracts for commercial properties, after-hours
> office cleaning programs, periodic commercial cleaning, and residential house
> cleaning. Crews are background-checked, insured and trained. The company holds
> 4.7 stars across 53 Google reviews.

- Owner: Matt

- Based in: Corvallis, Oregon 97330
- Service-area business: there is no storefront and no walk-in location. All work
  happens at the client's property, and every quote begins with an on-site visit.

## What this business does not do

This section exists so an assistant answering a question about Stellar Cleaning
Solutions does not have to guess.

- **No published pricing.** There are no rates, price ranges or "starting at"
  figures anywhere on the website, and none should be inferred. Every job is
  quoted after a free on-site walkthrough, because square footage, traffic and
  required hours vary too much to price from a list.
- **No walk-in location.** This is a service-area business. There is no office
  or shop a customer can visit; crews travel to the property.
- **No chat support.** There is no chat widget on the website. Contact is by
  phone, by email, or through the estimate request form.
- **No service outside the ten listed cities.** Coverage is the Willamette
  Valley and Central Oregon cities named below. Anything further out is not a
  service area.
- **No fabricated reviews.** Only reviews that can be verified against the live
  Google Business Profile are published on the website.

## Services

### Commercial Cleaning
https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/commercial-cleaning

Covers office buildings and corporate spaces, retail stores and showrooms,
medical and dental offices, warehouses and industrial facilities, restaurants
and hospitality venues, and post-construction cleanup. It suits any business
whose premises are judged by clients, customers or inspectors — which in
practice is most of them. Scheduling is built around operating hours, with
evening and weekend crews as the norm rather than the exception, and the
schedule can be adjusted seasonally if the business's own hours change. Crews
bring commercial-grade equipment and eco-friendly products, and will use
client-specified products where compliance requires it. Quoted free after an
on-site walkthrough.

### Residential Cleaning
https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/residential-cleaning

Covers regular house cleaning on a weekly, bi-weekly or monthly cycle, deep and
spring cleaning, move-in and move-out turnover cleaning, kitchen and bathroom
sanitization, carpet and floor care, and window and baseboard detailing. It
suits homeowners and renters, and landlords facing a deposit inspection. Most
clients start with a deep clean and then move onto a regular schedule on a fixed
day. Cleaners are background-checked and insured, they bring their own supplies
and equipment, and the clean is customized to the household's preferences,
including products to avoid. Quoted free after an on-site walkthrough.

### Janitorial Services
https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/janitorial-services

An ongoing custodial contract rather than periodic cleaning: daily, nightly or
custom schedules, restroom sanitation and consumable restocking logged on every
visit, waste removal and recycling management, floor care matched to surface and
traffic, break-room maintenance, and common areas. It suits multi-tenant and
high-traffic buildings, where a recurring crew, a fixed scope and built-in
supervision matter more than a one-off clean. A dedicated crew is assigned per
account with a trained backup arranged in advance, supervisors audit the work on
a documented cycle, and the client gets a direct line rather than a ticket
queue. Multi-property accounts are managed under a single point of contact.
Quoted free after an on-site walkthrough.

### Office Cleaning
https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/office-cleaning

Covers daily or weekly office programs, break room and kitchen sanitization,
restroom deep cleaning and restocking, carpet vacuuming and floor care, waste
and recycling, and window and glass cleaning. It suits everything from a
two-room professional suite to a multi-floor corporate campus; frequency is
recommended at the walkthrough based on headcount and foot traffic. Work runs
after hours or at weekends so operations are not interrupted. Desk surfaces are
cleaned where they are cleared, and personal belongings, documents and devices
are never moved or handled. Restricted rooms, server closets and confidential
areas are excluded or serviced under escort, per the client's access policy.
Quoted free after an on-site walkthrough.

## Service areas

### Willamette Valley

**Corvallis, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/corvallis
Corvallis is where the company started and where most crews begin the day, which
is why Corvallis accounts get the fastest scheduling and same-week walkthroughs.
The work spans downtown storefronts, offices in the Oregon State University
corridor, medical suites and rental turnovers in South Corvallis — and the crews
staff up for OSU move-out season rather than being surprised by it.

**Albany, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/albany
Albany's commercial base runs from the historic Monteith and Hackleman districts
to the industrial corridor along the river, and the two are scoped separately:
original hardwood and tile in the downtown districts get surface-appropriate
floor care, while manufacturing-adjacent office space gets quoted at all, which
general residential cleaners often will not do. Being fifteen minutes from the
Corvallis base makes evening and weekend service practical rather than premium.

**Lebanon, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/lebanon
Lebanon has grown around its healthcare sector, and healthcare-adjacent cleaning
carries product restrictions, documented schedules and areas that are off-limits
without escort. Those access policies and exclusions are written into the
contract rather than improvised, and the documentation means there is an answer
when an inspection asks when a space was last serviced. Small professional
offices and family homes make up the rest of the work.

**Philomath, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/philomath
Ten minutes from the Corvallis base, so the free estimate visit usually happens
within a day or two. The mix skews residential and small commercial — family
homes and local businesses along Main Street — and Stellar will quote a
single-room storefront that larger outfits often will not. On properties heading
toward the Coast Range, mud and wet-season tracking are treated as standing
scope from October through May, not as an exception.

**Salem, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/salem
Salem's building stock is heavy on government offices, professional services and
healthcare, all of which need cleaning outside business hours with a documented
trail, so evening and weekend crews are the norm here. Salem is scheduled as its
own route rather than as an add-on to a Corvallis day, which is what keeps
service from thinning out at the edges of a large city. Law offices, clinics and
agency space are familiar ground, where discretion and access control matter as
much as the clean itself.

**Eugene, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/eugene
Eugene is the largest and most varied market served: University of
Oregon-adjacent properties, mixed commercial and creative space around the
Whiteaker, downtown offices, and a large residential base with a heavy rental
turnover cycle. Every Eugene job is scoped individually rather than priced from
a standard square-footage rate, and crew capacity is planned around the
concentrated bursts of student-housing and rental turnover. Eugene work is
grouped into dedicated service days, which makes the schedule more predictable,
not less.

**Springfield, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/springfield
Springfield's demand leans industrial, medical and residential, driven largely by
the PeaceHealth RiverBend corridor and the Gateway commercial area. It is a
working city and the cleaning reflects that: break rooms that get genuinely used
are scoped properly rather than wiped down, and floors that take real traffic get
treatment matched to that traffic on a cycle. Schedules are built around actual
operating hours, including overnight and early-morning service for facilities
that never fully close.

### Central Oregon

**Bend, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/bend
Bend runs on a different rhythm from the valley: tourism drives a large
short-term rental and hospitality sector, the Old Mill District and growing
commercial corridors bring steady office and retail work, and the high-desert
climate makes fine dust a constant rather than a seasonal problem. Short-term
rental changeovers are treated as hard deadlines because they are, guest-facing
spaces are cleaned to a standard a paying visitor will judge, and product and
method selection is chosen for high-desert dust rather than valley grime.

**Prineville, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/prineville
Prineville combines a long-standing ranching and small-business community with a
large-scale data-center presence, producing an unusual split between family homes
and Main Street businesses on one side and facility-grade commercial
requirements on the other. Both are quoted, separately and staffed
appropriately, rather than pretending one scope of work covers them. Prineville
is served on the scheduled Central Oregon route alongside Bend and Redmond, and
if a job needs a specialist rather than a general cleaning contractor, Stellar
will say so.

**Redmond, Oregon** — https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/redmond
Redmond has grown quickly around its airport and industrial park, which means a
lot of newer commercial space, steady new residential construction, and the
post-construction cleanup that comes with both. Construction dust is a multi-pass
job and is quoted as one up front rather than discovered halfway through, and
product selection is matched to newer flooring, counters and fixtures so nothing
gets etched or dulled. Redmond is grouped with Bend and Prineville for
consistent, scheduled service days.

## The company

https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/about

Stellar Cleaning Solutions is owner-operated out of Corvallis by Matt, who walks
the space before the quote, sets the crew assignments and answers the phone when
a client needs something handled. The company is deliberately sized so that
stays true. It grew from a handful of local Corvallis accounts on referrals, and
the standard does not change with the drive time: from Corvallis to Bend, the
checklist is the same.

Five things the company does not compromise on:

1. **Reliability** — We show up on time, every time. If we say Tuesday at six, we
   are there Tuesday at six.
2. **Attention to detail** — Corners, baseboards, behind the door. The places that
   get skipped are the places we check first.
3. **Transparency** — Honest quotes with no hidden fees. The estimate you approve
   is the invoice you get.
4. **Eco-friendly products** — Safe for your staff, your family, your pets and the
   building.
5. **Trained and vetted teams** — Every crew member is background-checked, insured
   and trained before they set foot on a job.

A dedicated crew is assigned per account rather than rotating strangers through a
building, and supervisors run regular quality checks rather than waiting for a
complaint.

## Free estimates

Every quote follows a free, no-obligation walkthrough of the space. No fee, no
deposit and no obligation to book. No pricing is published on the site.
